name: Void Citadel
_: Region 4's boss (S5-4, feat/boss-region-4; docs/plans/s5-boss-regions.md §4.5 and §6.4; the owner's banner in docs/design/boss-banners/): the Void Citadel, the final regional boss. An octagonal fortress - one solid hull from end to end (rows 0-3, columns 14-49), the weapons set into it in two blocks, one each side of the centre - with the black void core at the centre and a salvo spire on a gantry at each end. Seen from below: the hull, the weapons in their bays, a one-row armour belt (row 4) under them, nothing below the belt (decision AP: one ship, armour reads as armour, the band ends at its last row). The gravity well (owner decision of 2026-10-13): while any spire stands, the player's ship is pulled sideways towards the core's column and the core pulses; destroying both spires switches the pull off and opens the core (its cover is the spires and the shutter plate in front of it). Phase A-2 (the owner's smoke of 2026-10-14): two laser cannons hug the core on both sides (slots 1 and 2), each behind its own belt plate, so the well pulls the ship across their beams; two more emitters (slots 3 and 4; every slot enabled on levels 10-12) and the outer guns sit behind the outer plates; two open guns stand in bays between the blocks and fire from the first frame. The boss falls with its last weapon - the core is one. Art drawn by the agent with scripts/boss-r4-art.mjs (decision G); the owner retouches the PNGs. Hit points (Phase A, trial t1 - docs/plans/s5-boss-regions.md §6.4.3): the opening values (spires 16, core 24, emitters 14, guns 10, plates 8 / 6 / 8 / 6 / 8) gave 161-246 s by the aiming bot's ratio; every value cut by about 40 % (spires 10, core 14, emitters 8, guns 6, plates 5 / 4 / 5 / 4 / 5) gives MEDIUM 108.4 / 108.8 / 129.7 s without the well, with G1 and with G2 - EASY and HARD are Phase B's tuning (EASY runs longer than MEDIUM, HARD 195-230 s).

palette._: COLPF0 pale steel (the belt's and the turrets' faces, the core's rim), COLPF1 mid steel (trim, edges), COLPF2 void magenta (the core's glow, the spires' coils, lights, damage glow, sparks; hue 326, clear of the ally steel $84 at 226 on levels 10-12), COLPF3 the hull's dark violet bulk (hue 294).

motion._: As region 1: one colour clock every 2 frames across 63 and back, from 32; the window shows band columns 4-59 over the travel.

fire._: One countdown as region 1; the finale on (fire.finaleCooldown, the S5-2 placeholders' value for regions 2-4): the final boss's worst case.

escort._: Region 1's cadence (owner decision AI, regions 2-4 follow region 1): the first escort at the first weapon kill, then one every 150 + 0..63 frames.

capped._: Never used on levels 10-12 (tier 4 enables every slot); the converter requires it.

gravity._: S5-4 (owner decisions of 2026-10-13 / 2026-10-14): the gravity well. While either spire stands, in the fight, the ship alive, the ship steps 2 colour clocks towards the axis every framesPerStep frames (G1); the core pulses (its hit flash) every pulseFrames; the gravity column (missile M0, white) shows the axis from the band down, an S-wave moving waveStep lines every 8 frames, flaring in the axis's warning, giving way to its beam. The axis is core-lens's beam: the well pulls the ship into its danger (owner answer 4). Both spires destroyed: the pull, the pulse and the column stop at once.

nozzles._: The citadel's vents: one cell each side in the hull's side, at its foot, pointing at the spire (region 1's nozzle phases) - nothing floats once a spire has fallen.

modules._: The void core (owner answer 4 of 2026-10-14: 3 x 3, round on screen). It cannot be hurt while a spire or its lens stands.
modules.name: core

modules._: The core's own beam (owner answer 4 of 2026-10-14: the well must pull the player into danger): the lens under the core fires down the gravity column - the well's axis is its beam, the column flares in its warning. Exposed from the first frame, the toughest weapon; destroying it ends the axis's danger.
modules.name: core-lens

modules._: The laser cannons beside the core (Phase A-2, the owner's smoke of 2026-10-14), each behind its own belt plate; independent (owner answer 3).
modules.name: cannon-l
